name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Wants to Move On From the Middle East. It’s Not Letting Him.
changes.summary: President Trump is eager to declare success in Iran and Gaza, but he is struggling to impose his will in either conflict.

changes.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
changes.summary: Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”.

changes.title: Homeland Security Intensifies Pursuit of Noncitizens on Voter Rolls
changes.summary: Immigrants who said they inadvertently registered to vote while obtaining or renewing driver’s licenses are increasingly facing deportation under the Trump administration.

changes.title: Trump signs order on vaccination recommendations
changes.summary: President Trump signed an executive order on childhood vaccine schedules Monday.

changes.title: Doctors respond to Trump's vaccine executive order as kids head back to school
changes.summary: President Trump signed an executive order on Monday that lowers the recommended number of vaccines for children and encourages splitting up certain vaccines into separate doctor visits. Doctors spoke with CBS News about the order and suggested that parents speak with their children's pediatricians about what would be b.

changes.title: Recount puts Trump-backed challenger in the lead in Indiana state Senate primary
changes.summary: State Sen. Spencer Deery, who now trails Republican Paula Copenhaver by three votes, said he will appeal.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump hid in an airport catering container and was taken to a military jet for a secret flight out of country after the NATO summit last month.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Voters in six states head to the polls Tuesday for high-profile primaries, Trump signals his strategy with Iran is shifting, 7.4 magnitude earthquake kills at least 111 people in Colombia.

changes.title: A year in, thousands of armed troops have quietly become a fixture of D.C. life
changes.summary: President Trump's deployment of the National Guard hits the one year mark next week. The presence of armed, uniformed troops on the street has become increasingly normalized in the capital.
